  The use of “Chancellor” suggests a federal or parliamentary system (e.g., Germany), but the concept applies broadly to any nation with a strong executive figure.

  The word “evil” is emotionally charged—it frames the nation’s struggles as a battle between good and evil, which can mobilize public support but may also oversimplify complex issues.
